notes.title: Veteran Levels
notes.content:
You asked for it and here it is!

This update lets your characters reach level 100! To keep things balanced, progression after level 50 now takes a different path with three new attributes. These are distinct from Power, Speed, and Mind, but still closely tied to them. Each of the new stats can be leveled up to 50:

🛡️ MIGHT[list]
[*] +1 Health per level
[*] +1% Vigor Save per level
[*] +0.1 Armor per level
[/list]

💨 FLAIR[list]
[*] +1 Guard per level
[*] +0.1 Guard Recovery per level
[*] +1% Reflex Save per level
[*] +0.1 Move per level
[/list]

🧠 WISDOM[list]
[*] +0.1 Skills per level
[*] +1% Will Save per level
[*] +0.1 Magic Armor per level
[*] +0.1 Mastery XP Boost per level
[/list]

All relevant tooltips have been updated to show the new values and there's a brand new Rosetta panel on the character screen to track everything at a glance:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44598471/dbb8dbbfae797cd023a460d5e60785cb11c05cb3.png[/img]

This is the last major update before version 1.0, which arrives in August! A special promotion is planned for June 16th, your final chance before the price goes up with v1.0.

To everyone who’s helped shape this game over the years: thank you. It’s been a 5-year solo journey, and I’m so proud of where we’ve landed. If you’ve enjoyed the game, please consider leaving a review, it really helps new players discover it!

Cheers,
Kezarus

notes.title: More tools for Modders!
notes.content:

Just open the Options Menu and check Mod Tools:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44598471/a5a5f67ab58162e4a3e7bb328f8eca1cc35f3950.png[/img]

notes.content:

The rewards at the end vary depending on which Seal you challenge, choose wisely!

notes.title: 🛡️ Citizenship Update & QoL Improvements ⚔️
notes.content:
The Citizenship Upgrade is here! 🎉 Now your group of adventurers can visit the Tavern and choose to become a Citizen of the town, unlocking some cool new privileges:
[list]
[*]Luxury Inn: Rest in style at an expensive inn, doubling your recovery rate.
[*]Banquet: Celebrate with a full stomach for extra bonuses.
[*]Fund Building: Help shape the town’s growth and unlock the facilities you need.
[*]New Hamlet: Build a new town nearby and expand your territory.
[/list]

[*]Meteoric Bow now deals splash damage.
[*]Dialogue Streamlining: Internal changes made to prepare for the upcoming Mod Support update.
[*]Map Interaction: Pressing Esc now clears the MapQuery. If no query is active, it opens the Menu.

[*]Combat Bar Update: Added action indicator for better clarity during combat.
[*]Dual Wilder:[list]
[*]Offhand weapons now deal half the damage of the corresponding hand weapon of the same tier.
[*]Adjusted damage amplitudes to better balance two-handed and hand/offhand weapons:[list]
[*]Two-Handed:[list]
[*].10 → .25
[*].25 → .33
[*].50 → .50[/list]
[*]Hand/Offhand:[list]
[*].50 → .33[/list][/list]

notes.title: Some Changes and a Fix
notes.content:
Starting the week strong with a fast update! I was already cooking a few improvements and the QA already gave the green light, so I decided to bundle them with a critical bug fix. This patch brings balance tweaks, QoL upgrades, some love to towns and Evil Centers and a few spicy skill changes.

Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] Party Screen: Click 'R' or 'S' to jump straight to the Relations or Skills menu.
[*] Overseer Routine: Every in-game day, the map now checks if each race has a Town. If not, one will be created.
[*] Pan on Edge: New option to toggle edge-panning on or off in the Options menu.
[*] Skill XP: Arcane Traits and Arcane Focus now grant extra skill uses for Mastery progression.
[*] Multiple Master Skills: Characters can now hold multiple Master Skills, as long as they aren’t in a Master Quest.
[*] Town Shop – Balance:
[list]
[*] Reduced base sell modifiers.
[*] Town Shop Events: cap the buy/sell bonus to 50%.
[*] UI tweaks to fit more buttons on the left panel.
[/list]
[*] Evil Centers: Difficulty now scales with your party’s level. Good luck! XD
[*] New Game+: On starting a new game, choose to keep your current party or make a new one. Pick a fresh world either way.
[*] Skill Changes:
[list]
[*] Shadow Move: Teleport (Speed x2)
[*] Far Shadow Move: Speed x3
[*] Dodging Shadow Move: Guard Bonus (Speed x2)
[*] Defensive Shadow Move: Guard Bonus (Speed x2)
[*] Black Magic: Now have Drain 2.
[*] Hold Crowd & Hold Horde: Now are friendly fire.
[/list]
[*] Legendaries: Can now be modified.
[*] Illusory Mage (Master Skill): Added skills: Passive True Sight, Mind Leak, Counterspell.
[*] Bug Fix: Fixed crash caused by Vine spells.
[/list]

Thanks for all the bug reports and suggestions, mates! You're helping me a ton to make the best game I can. I really do have the best players I could ask for! Stay tuned for the next updates, I'm cooking something big! ^_~


Cheers!

notes.title: Your Feedback in Action!
notes.content:
Hey-a, adventurers!

You ask, and I deliver! As you’ve probably noticed, I’m very active on the Steam forums, listening to your feedback and working hard to bring your suggestions to life. I want Endless RPG to be the best it can be, and that means updates, improvements, and, of course, squashing bugs (you know how much I hate those).

Here’s what’s new in Update 0.8.8f:

🛠 Changes & Improvements:
✅ Balancing – Ruins and Caves adjusted (more tweaks coming!).
✅ Magic as a Stat – Now visible on Combat Query and Party Screen.
✅ ESC Key Fix – Now properly closes info panels.
✅ Guard Bonus Limit – Capped at 20 for a simpler, more intuitive system, any new bonus is just added to the Guard pool until 20 at maximum.
✅ Splash Damage Adjustment – Now deals half-damage instead of 7 maximum.
✅ Dismissed Characters – They’ll now stay nearby instead of wandering too far.
✅ Foraging Nerf – Reduced material yield.
✅ Relations Cooldown – Now 12 hours instead of 8 hours.
✅ Right-Click to Remove Traits – Easier trait management.
✅ Forced Relation Dialogue Removed – No more forced interactions.
✅ Event Delays – Increased from 1 to 3 days.
✅ Magic Amplitude Explained Better – Clarity matters!
✅ Armor Wreak Skill Description Updated – Now specifies it only triggers on health damage.
✅ "Maneuver" Removed from Skill Descriptions – Simplifying terminology.
✅ Character Stat Tracking Added:
▶️Kills
▶️Times knocked out
▶️Attacks made/received/evaded
▶️Damage dealt/received
▶️Buffs cast
▶️Days in the party
✅ Edge Scrolling Added – Move the camera by pushing to screen edges.
✅ Weapon Requirement Displayed in Combat – No more guesswork.
✅ New Town Contract: Diplomacy – More ways to interact with the world.
✅ Investigation Contracts Reworked – No more memorizing quests, you actually have to investigate!
✅ [CRASH] Rare Silent Crash at Loot Screen – I’ve reinforced the code everywhere I could. If you encounter this bug, please try to reproduce it and send me the details!

💬 A Huge Thanks to You!
I can’t say this enough—thank you for your support, feedback, and ideas! This game is growing because of you, and I truly appreciate it.

📝 Want to help even more? Please consider leaving a review on Steam! Reviews help a ton by making the game more visible. If you’re enjoying Endless RPG, let others know!

See you in the next adventure! ⚔️🛡️


Cheers! =]
Kezarus

notes.title: Legendary Weapons & Armors Have Arrived!
notes.content:
Adventurers, get ready! The Ruins just got a lot more exciting. Legendary weapons and armors have been added to Endless RPG! These powerful relics of the past are now scattered across the world inside the Ruins, waiting to be claimed by those bold enough to seek them out.

💎 What makes them special?

[list]
[*] Abilities and stats beyond anything you've found before.
[*] A true test of luck and exploration, who knows what you'll uncover?

[/list]

Get ready to explore, fight, and loot like never before! Let us know what legendary items you find first.

⚔️ Time to make history! ⚔️

notes.title: Choose Your Challenge! Difficulty Options Are Here!
notes.content:
Adventurers, your journey through Endless RPG just got even better! We're excited to introduce Difficulty Options, giving you the power to shape your adventure the way you want.

[h1]How It Works[/h1]
You can now select your difficulty when starting a new game or adjust it anytime from the Options Menu during your playthrough. Whether you crave a tough challenge or a more relaxed experience, the choice is yours.

[h1]The New Difficulties[/h1]
[h2]Standard[/h2]
The game as intended. A balanced challenge where strategy matters, but mistakes won't ruin you.

[h2]Relaxed[/h2]
A softer challenge. Enemies are weaker, giving you more room to experiment and recover from mistakes. (Enemies have -25% Health, Guard, and Damage.)

[h2]Casual[/h2]
A carefree adventure. Enemies pose little threat, letting you focus on the journey rather than the struggle. (Enemies have -50% Health, Guard, and Damage.)


Whether you're here for the thrill of battle or just to enjoy the world, we got you covered.
Got feedback? Let us know in the discussions. Happy adventuring!

notes.title: Event System Update!
notes.content:
Adventurers, a major update has arrived! We’re introducing a brand-new Event System, bringing dynamic encounters and richer storytelling to Endless RPG: Untold Tales.

Now, many events can occur during your playthrough, influenced by your party composition, weather, biome, and even the current moon phase! These events can be expanded in future updates and are fully customizable by players. Since they are configured via JSON, a complete document with instructions and in-game examples is available for easy modification.

notes.title: Enhancing Your Gameplay Experience
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we have some exciting updates and bug fixes to share with you regarding our latest development progress:

From now on, all demo versions will have a level cap (Max Level 3) and a 25 in-game day limit. You can always create a new world and play again up to day 25! Also, all improvements and updates will be carried out on the demo and on the final version.

Here is the list of what was changed:

[list]
[*] Hotkeys Fixed: We've corrected an issue where the speed button hotkeys were not functioning as intended.
[*] Healing Feedback: When healing via dialogue, such as at a campfire, the system will now accurately display the amount of health restored, even if your character is already at maximum health.
[*] AI Archer Behaviour: We have refined the behaviour of AI archers, discouraging them from dashing and instead focusing on movement, making combat more predictable.
[*] Dungeon Darkness: We have implemented a new darkness effect for all ruins and caves, featuring a black spotlight that follows the mouse or the character, which enhances the atmosphere in combats and dialogues.
[*] Skill Generation Bug: A bug where some Skill buildings were not generating skills has been fixed. This issue was most likely occurring when the town grew.
[*] Dialogue System Bug: We've addressed a bug in the dialogue engine that was causing issues when a party member was deceased. The system now cycles properly even when a character has died.
[*] Caves Crash Fix: A crash that would occur when the party wiped while gathering ore in caves has been resolved.
[*] Speed Button Functionality: The map speed button now correctly cycles through pause.
[*] Town Display: The town will now correctly display the shop as the default tab.
[*] Town Shop Improvements: The exit button in the town shop now includes a tooltip that indicates the ‘Esc’ key is the hotkey to exit.
[*] Visual clarity:
[list]
[*] We've added a line to separate qualities from other properties in the UI.
[*] We've added an explanation to the UI as to why a skill is not active, for example due to missing equipment.
[/list]
[*] Character Appearance: The "Unliving" skill now pales the character's skin.
[*] Map Sprite Update: We have redone the character troops sprites and have ensured they will not appear blurry.
[*] Map Arrow: We have corrected the map arrows to prevent them from being squashed, and have adjusted their position.
[*] Map Icons: The Evil Center map icons are now preserved with pixel-perfect quality.
[/list]

notes.title: 🐞Bug Bashing👾

If you encounter any bugs, please share the step-by-step process to help us reproduce and fix them on our end. Thanks so much for your support and patience!

notes.title: Endless RPG - First Quest

notes.title: ⚔️ Endless RPG Demo is Here! ⚔️
notes.content:
Greetings, adventurers!

It is with great joy and a hopeful heart that we welcome you to explore Endless RPG! Dive into a living, open world with engaging turn-based combat, where the adventure never truly ends.

This demo isn’t just a taste, it’s the full game in its current development state. We’ll keep it available like this until February, so you can enjoy the complete Endless experience.

We’d love to hear your thoughts! Drop a comment, share your experience, and let us know how we can improve before the full release. Your feedback is invaluable as we prepare for Early Access!

So, grab your sword, summon your courage, and let the adventure begin!

🕹️ Play the Demo Now
👉 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2586000/]Store Page[/url]

notes.title: Launch Date: early March
notes.content:
Hello, adventurers!

I want to share an update about Endless RPG’s release plans. The Early Access launch will be moving to early March instead of January. This wasn’t an easy decision, but it’s crucial to give the game the best possible start and I need your help to make it happen.

Right now, Endless RPG has about 340 wishlists, but to succeed, I need many more. That’s why I’ll be showcasing the game at Steam NextFest at the end of February. It’s a huge opportunity to grow our community, and the extra time will help ensure the Early Access release is polished and full of charm.


To make the wait worthwhile:
[list]
[*]I’ll be releasing a fully-featured demo by January, so you can dive in and experience everything the game has to offer.
[*]If you’d like to go the extra mile and support the project, I’ve set up a [url=https://buymeacoffee.com/kezarus]Buy Me a Coffee[/url] page. Every little bit helps keep this dream alive.
[/list]

I won’t sugarcoat it, this is make-or-break for me. If the wishlist trend doesn’t pick up, this game may be my last. But I’m holding onto hope because of all of you who’ve supported me so far. Together, I believe we can make Endless RPG the success it deserves to be.

Thank you for sticking with me. Please keep sharing the game with your friends, wishlist if you haven’t already, and stay tuned for more exciting updates as we prepare for NextFest. Let’s make this journey unforgettable!

Cheers!
Kezarus

notes.title: Quests are Available!!!

Our latest update brings a massive overhaul with a fully Quest Engine! 🎉 Quests are dynamic, with new rewards, complex interactions, and better tracking to shape your journey across the lands.

To get the full experience, we recommend starting a new game so you can enjoy the updated quest system right from the beginning.

Try it out, explore the new layers of gameplay, and let us know what you think. Your feedback fuels our adventures!

Happy questing, mates! 🛡️✨

[*]Enhanced Quests Engine with categories, subcategories, town info gathering, and filtering based on tier.

notes.title: Endless RPG Update: Exciting Things Ahead!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

I wanted to share a quick update on the progress of Endless RPG. While I was aiming for a September release, a few things have taken a bit longer than expected—especially the final dialogues for the Evil Centers. But don’t worry, I’m working hard to get everything just right!

On the bright side, I’m making great strides with the Tutorials and Quest System, which are crucial parts of the game. I’ll be rolling out updated versions on itch.io as I continue to polish things up, so you can still dive in and see the progress firsthand and for free.

I’ll also be putting more effort into marketing to get the word out about Endless RPG. While this might not be the best place to ask for help, any support from you is always appreciated! I will make some videos (long and short) as soon as I can.

Thanks so much for your patience and love. I’m committed to delivering the best experience possible, and I’m excited for what’s to come.

Cheers!
